import re

_ISO_WEEK_RE = re.compile(r"^(\d{4})-W(\d{2})-([1-7])$")

from datetime import timedelta

"""ISO week dates like 2026-W05-3."""

import re
from datetime import date


_ISO_WEEK_RE = re.compile(r"^(\d{4})-W(\d{2})-([1-7])$")


def parse_iso_week(text):
    """Return the date for an ISO week date string YYYY-Www-D (ISO year, ISO week, ISO weekday 1=Mon..7=Sun)."""
    m = _ISO_WEEK_RE.match(text)
    if not m:
